A rhythm that fits.

Recording mode keeps the original durations in your script. An editor can expand each pause later. Speech time is always an estimate.

Use an external recording tool if you’re capturing a take. Teleprompt Your Way never listens or records.

Separate paragraphs with a blank line. Optional: # section headings, [pause 3s], [stage: smile], [breath 4s: breathe naturally]. Directions never become narration.
